title: No Dialog Warning Icon
description: Removes the dialog warning icon from Minecraft dialogs.
body:
![Before](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4809df8120eaef6d60cd33679e4e504d56067040.png)
![After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/481a7f7d811bd9e22922e687a3bb38cf038d3002.png)

**Removes the warning icon shown in custom Minecraft dialogs.**

_Because it's just ugly to have in dialogs._
